title: MOZA AB6 Airbus Stick & MTQ Throttle MSFS Setup Guide (A320 Profile)
description:
Setting up realistic Airbus airliner controls in Microsoft Flight Simulator requires getting every axis, detent, and switch configured just right. With the release of Sim Update 7, the new Lufthansa liveries, and the MOZA Airbus Sidestick grip, it is time to build the ultimate airliner control layout using the MOZA Flight AB6 base and the MTQ Throttle quadrant.

In this comprehensive, step-by-step setup guide, we walk through configuring the MOZA AB6 Airbus Sidestick and MTQ Throttle from scratch for the Microsoft / iniBuilds A320neo (and compatible Airbus airliners) in MSFS 2024 and 2020. We tackle common simulator binding headaches—including MSFS profile renaming quirks, calibrating reverse thrust detents, and setting up the MTQ speedbrake in mixed mode so analog spoiler extension and digital arming clicks work seamlessly. We also cover how to configure nosewheel steering, autopilot disconnects, rotary encoders for heading/altitude, and how to map rudder control to base sliders if you do not have dedicated rudder pedals.

Avoid the trial-and-error, bypass the MSFS binding bugs, and download my custom profiles to get your flight deck fully operational in minutes.

📥 Download my custom MSFS MOZA AB6 & MTQ Control Profiles: https://highintheflightsimsky.nl/controllers/
REMARK: both separate and combined profiles are available
